info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Operations Status API
info.description: The Credit Risk Operations Status API provides insight into the current status of credit risk operations within wholesale trading. This endpoint allows users to query the operational state of credit risk assessments, helping trading teams and risk managers stay informed about potential exposures and compliance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and regulatory bodies who monitor credit risk metrics. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their risk management strategies and ensure timely decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of credit risk operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest status of the credit risk operations within the wholesale trading system. It provides crucial information regarding the operational status, helping inform decision-making and risk assessments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of credit risk operations in wholesale trading. Ensure that the request contains the necessary parameters to correctly identify the operation status being queried.
